title: micropus tenellus
intro: Micropus tenellus, commonly known as Tenellus, is a flowering plant species within the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is primarily native to the mountainous regions of Central and South America. The plant has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may aid in wound healing, reducing fever, and relieving respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Tenellus include sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects.
